text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara (SEAMEO)

(Keistimewaan dan Kekebalan) 2012.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Julai 2012.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna

yang lain—

"Badan-badan subsidiari" ertinya pusat serantau yang ditubuhkan di bawah

Organ Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara yang dinyatakan dalam

Jadual;

"Organ" ertinya organ-organ yang ditubuhkan oleh Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri

Pendidikan Asia Tenggara yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual;

"pegawai" ertinya seseorang pegawai Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan

Asia Tenggara tetapi tidak termasuk pegawai tempatan;

"Pegawai Tinggi" ertinya seseorang yang memegang jawatan ketua eksekutif

bagi setiap Organ atau badan-badan subsidiari Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan

Asia Tenggara dan, dalam hal apabila suatu badan subsidiari mempunyai pejabat di

Malaysia, ketua badan subsidiari tersebut juga di Malaysia;

"Persidangan Antarabangsa" ertinya semua aktiviti yang dianjurkan oleh Organ

di bawah Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara termasuk mesyuarat,

persidangan, forum, seminar, bengkel, penyelidikan dan kursus;

"Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara" ertinya pertubuhan

yang ditubuhkan melalui Piagam Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia

Tenggara yang ditandatangani di Singapura pada 7 Februari 1968 dan termasuklah

Organnya dan badan-badan subsidiari yang ditubuhkan di bawah Organ itu.

Pengisytiharan Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara menjadi

organisasi antarabangsa

3. Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara diisytiharkan menjadi

suatu organisasi antarabangsa yang baginya seksyen 4 Akta terpakai.

Keperibadian juridikal

4. Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara hendaklah mempunyai

keperibadian juridikal dan hendaklah mempunyai keupayaan―

(a) untuk membuat kontrak;

(b) untuk memperoleh, memegang dan melupuskan harta alih dan harta tak

alih; dan

(c) untuk memulakan prosiding undang-undang.

Keistimewaan dan kekebalan Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia

Tenggara

5. Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara hendaklah mempunyai

keistimewaan dan kekebalan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama Akta.

Keistimewaan dan kekebalan Pegawai Tinggi

6. (1) Pegawai Tinggi hendaklah mempunyai keistimewaan dan kekebalan

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Bahagian I Jadual Kedua Akta.

(2) Seseorang bekas Pegawai Tinggi hendaklah mempunyai kekebalan

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Bahagian II Jadual Kedua Akta.

Keistimewaan dan kekebalan orang yang ditauliahkan kepada, atau yang hadir di,

persidangan antarabangsa yang dianjurkan oleh Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri

Pendidikan Asia Tenggara

7. (1) Seseorang yang ditauliahkan kepada Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri

Pendidikan Asia Tenggara, atau yang hadir di, sesuatu persidangan antarabangsa yang

dianjurkan oleh Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara sebagai wakil―

(a) suatu negara selain Malaysia;

(b) suatu organisasi antarabangsa; atau

(c) suatu organisasi seberang laut,

hendaklah mempunyai keistimewaan dan kekebalan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan

dalam Bahagian I Jadual Ketiga Akta.

(2) Seseorang yang tidak lagi ditauliahkan kepada Pertubuhan MenteriMenteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara, atau yang telah hadir di, sesuatu persidangan,

sebagai wakil, hendaklah mempunyai kekebalan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam

Bahagian II Jadual Ketiga Akta.

Keistimewaan dan kekebalan pegawai selain Pegawai Tinggi

8. (1) Seseorang pegawai hendaklah mempunyai keistimewaan dan kekebalan

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Bahagian I Jadual Keempat Akta.

(2) Seseorang bekas pegawai hendaklah mempunyai kekebalan sebagaimana

yang dinyatakan dalam Bahagian II Jadual Keempat Akta.

Keistimewaan dan kekebalan orang yang sedang berkhidmat dalam

jawatankuasa atau sedang mengambil bahagian dalam kerja, atau sedang

melaksanakan misi bagi pihak, Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia

Tenggara

9. (1) Seseorang yang sedang berkhidmat dalam sesuatu jawatankuasa yang

ditubuhkan oleh Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara atau yang

sedang mengambil bahagian dalam kerja, atau yang sedang melaksanakan suatu misi

bagi pihak Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara hendaklah

mempunyai keistimewaan dan kekebalan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam

Bahagian I Jadual Kelima Akta.

(2) Seseorang yang telah berkhidmat dalam jawatankuasa atau yang telah

mengambil bahagian dalam kerja atau yang telah melaksanakan suatu misi hendaklah

mempunyai kekebalan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Bahagian II Jadual Kelima

Akta.

Penepian

10. (1) Persidangan Majlis Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia

Tenggara hendaklah mempunyai hak untuk mengetepikan kekebalan yang diberikan

kepada Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara daripada apa-apa

proses undang-undang selain pelaksanaannya.

(2) Sesuatu Negara Anggota Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia

Tenggara atau Ketua Organ atau badan subsidiari kepada Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri

Pendidikan Asia Tenggara hendaklah mempunyai kuasa dan kewajipan untuk

mengetepikan keistimewaan dan kekebalan yang diberikan kepada mana-mana orang

yang ditauliahkan kepada Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara, atau

yang hadir dalam Persidangan Antarabangsa yang dianjurkan oleh Pertubuhan MenteriMenteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara sebagai wakilnya jika, pada pandangan Negara

Anggota atau Ketua Organ, keistimewaan dan kekebalan itu akan menghalang

perjalanan keadilan dan boleh diketepikan tanpa menjejaskan maksud yang baginya

kekebalan itu diberikan.

(3) Persidangan Majlis Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara (SEAMEC)

hendaklah mempunyai kuasa dan kewajipan untuk mengetepikan keistimewaan dan

kekebalan yang diberikan kepada mana-mana Pegawai Tinggi atau pegawai kepada

Organ atau badan subsidiari Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara

atau pegawai atau mana-mana orang yang sedang berkhidmat dalam Organ atau yang

sedang mengambil bahagian dalam kerja, atau yang sedang melaksanakan apa-apa misi

bagi pihak Organ atau badan-badan subsidiari Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan

Asia Tenggara jika, pada pendapatnya, keistimewaan dan kekebalan itu akan

menghalang perjalanan keadilan dan boleh diketepikan tanpa menjejaskan kepentingan

Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara.

JADUAL

ORGAN-ORGAN DAN BADAN-BADAN SUBSIDIARI

[Peraturan 2]

1. Organ-organ adalah seperti yang berikut:

(a) Majlis Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara (SEAMEC)

(b) Sekretariat Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara (SEAMES)

2. Badan-badan subsidiari adalah seperti yang berikut:

(a) Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara Pusat Serantau

bagi Pendidikan Sains dan Matematik (SEAMEO RECSAM)

(b) Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara Pusat Serantau

bagi Pendidikan Khas (SEAMEO SEN)

(c) Pertubuhan Menteri-Menteri Pendidikan Asia Tenggara Pusat Serantau

bagi Rangkaian Perubatan Tropika dan Kesihatan Awam

(SEAMEO TROPMED)

Dibuat 8 Mei 2012

[KP HA 008.5.13 Jld. 1 (51); PN(PU2 )507/III]

DATO' SRI ANIFAH HJ AMAN

Menteri Luar Negeri

Bertarikh 5 Jun 2012

DATO' SERI HAJI AHMAD HUSNI BIN MOHAMAD HANADZLAH

Menteri Kewangan Kedua

INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS (PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES) ACT 1992

SOUTHEAST ASIAN MINISTERS OF EDUCATION ORGANIZATION (SEAMEO)

(PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES) REGULATIONS 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsections 3(1) and 4(1) and section 11 of the

International Organizations (Privileges and Immunities) Act 1992 [Act 485], the

Minister, with the concurrence of the Minister of Finance, makes the following

regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Southeast Asian Ministers of

Education Organization (SEAMEO) (Privileges and Immunities) Regulations 2012.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 July 2012.

Interpretation

2. In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—

"Subsidiary bodies" means the regional centres established under the Organs of

the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization as specified in the Schedule;

"Organs" means the organs established by the Southeast Asian Ministers of

Education Organization as specified in the Schedule;

"officer" means an officer of the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education

Organization but does not include an officer who is engaged locally;

"High Officer" means the person holding the post of the executive head of each of

the Organs or subsidiary bodies of the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education

Organization and, in the case where a subsidiary body has an office in Malaysia, the

head of the said subsidiary body in Malaysia;

"International Conference" means all activities organized by the Organs under

the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization which includes meetings,

conferences, forums, seminars, workshops, research and courses;

"Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization" means the organization

set up by the Charter of the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization signed

in Singapore on 7 February 1968 and includes its Organs and the subsidiary bodies

established under the Organs.

Declaration of the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization to be an

international organization

3. The Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization is declared to be an

international organization to which section 4 of the Act applies.

Juridical personality

4. The Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization shall have juridical

personality and shall have the capacity―

(a) to contract;

(b) to acquire, hold and dispose of movable and immovable property; and

(c) to institute legal proceedings.

Privileges and immunities of the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education

Organization

5. The Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization shall have the

privileges and immunities as specified in the First Schedule to the Act.

Privileges and immunities of High Officer

6. (1) A High Officer shall have the privileges and immunities as specified in

Part I of the Second Schedule to the Act.

(2) A former High Officer shall have the immunities as specified in Part II of

the Second Schedule to the Act.

Privileges and immunities of persons accredited to, or attending, an international

conference convened by the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization

7. (1) A person who is accredited to Southeast Asian Ministers of Education

Organization or is in attendance at, an international conference convened by the

Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization as a representative of—

(a) a country other than Malaysia;

(b) an international organization; or

(c) an overseas organization,

shall have the privileges and immunities as specified in Part I of the Third Schedule to

the Act.

(2) A person who has ceased to be accredited to the Southeast Asian

Ministers of Education Organization, or has attended the conference, as the

representative, shall have the immunities as specified in Part II of the Third Schedule to

the Act.

Privileges and immunities of Officer other than High Officer

8. (1) An officer shall have the privileges and immunities as specified in Part I of

the Fourth Schedule to the Act.

(2) A former officer shall have the immunities as specified in Part II of the

Fourth Schedule to the Act.

Privileges and immunities of persons serving on committee or participating in the

work of, or performing mission on behalf of, the Southeast Asian Ministers of

Education Organization

9. (1) A person who is serving on a committee established by the Southeast

Asian Ministers of Education Organization or is participating in the work of, or

performing a mission on behalf of the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education

Organization shall have the privileges and immunities as specified in Part I of the Fifth

Schedule to the Act.

(2) A person who has served on the committee or participated in the work or

has performed such a mission shall have the immunities as specified in Part II of the

Fifth Schedule to the Act.

Waiver

10. (1) The Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Council Conference shall have

the right to waive the immunities conferred on the Southeast Asian Ministers of

Education Organization from any legal process other than its execution.

(2) A Member State of the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education

Organization or the head of an Organ or subsidiary body of the Southeast Asian

Ministers of Education Organization shall have the power and duty to waive the

privileges and immunities conferred on any person who is accredited to the Southeast

Asian Ministers of Education Organization, or is in attendance at an international

conference convened by, the Southeast Asian Minister of Education Organization as its

representatives where, in the opinion of such Member State or such head, the privileges

and immunities would impede the course of justice and can be waived without

prejudicing the purposes for which they were conferred.

(3) The Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Council Conference (SEAMEC)

shall have the power and duty to waive the privileges and immunities conferred on any

High Officer or officer of an Organ or subsidiary body of the Southeast Asian Ministers of

Education Organization or official or any person who is serving or is participating in the

work of, or performing any mission on behalf if the Organs or subsidiary bodies of the

Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization where, in its opinion, the

privileges and immunities would impede the course of justice and can be waived

without prejudicing the interests of the Southeast Asian Ministers of Education

Organization.

SCHEDULE

ORGANS AND SUBSIDIARY BODIES

[Regulation 2]

1. The Organs are as follows:

(a) Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Council (SEAMEC)

(b) Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Secretariat (SEAMES)

2. The subsidiary bodies are as follows:

(a) Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization Regional Center for

Education in Science and Mathematics (SEAMEO RECSAM)

(b) Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization Regional Center for

Special Education (SEAMEO SEN)

(c) Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization Regional Tropical

Medicine and Public Health Network (SEAMEO TROPMED)

Made 8 May 2012
